description_en: Queries the trend of API security risks for a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-abnormal-trend --instance-id waf-cn-uqm342yj000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserAbnormalTrend

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.

This parameter is applicable only to hybrid cloud scenarios. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to obtain the hybrid cloud cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Trend.description_en: The list of API security risk trend data points

items.description_en: The details of a risk trend data point

AbnormalHigh.description_en: The number of high-severity security risks

AbnormalLow.description_en: The number of low-severity security risks

AbnormalMedium.description_en: The number of medium-severity security risks

TimeStamp.description_en: The point in time when the statistics were collected. This value is a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: seconds
TimeStamp.description_zh:
统计的时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。


<notice>参数已弃用，建议使用Timestamp参数。</notice>

Timestamp.description_en: The point in time when the statistics were collected. This value is a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: seconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 统计的时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
